text: I think traditions connect people with their history and give them a feeling of identity. If a country loses its traditions, it can become difficult to tell it apart from others. In my country, for instance, hospitality is a very important custom, and I'm proud of it. At the same time, traditions should change a little with the times, otherwise young people may lose interest.

tips.en: A direct answer followed by a reason makes the response logical and coherent.
tips.kk: Алдымен тікелей жауап, содан кейін себебі — жауап логикалы әрі байланысты шығады.
tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — ответ звучит логично и связно.
tips.example: traditions connect people with their history

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: At the same time, traditions should change

questions.followUp: Which traditions are important in your country?
questions.question: Why is it important to keep traditions alive?

text: Some are, but many are more influenced by global trends, like foreign music or films. That isn't necessarily bad, because it makes them open-minded. However, I do think schools should teach local history and folk art in a more interesting way, for example through projects or trips to museums. When it's fun, young people usually pay more attention.

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: Some are, but many are more influenced

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: for example through projects or trips to museums

questions.question: Do you think young people are interested in their own culture?

text: On the one hand, it brings people closer, and we can enjoy food, music and fashion from all over the world. On the other hand, small local cultures may disappear, because big international brands are everywhere. I think the key is balance. People can enjoy foreign things but still keep their own language and customs, and the government can support this with festivals and education.

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: On the one hand, it brings people closer

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.
tips.example: I think the key is balance

questions.followUp: Can anything be done about it?
questions.question: How does globalisation affect local cultures?

text: I think so, at least for local residents. If museums are free, more people, especially children and students, will visit them and learn something. Of course, museums need money, so the state or sponsors should pay. Some countries also have free days once a month, which is a sensible compromise in my view. Everyone should have a chance to enjoy art.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.
tips.example: I think so, at least for local residents

tips.en: Natural word combinations show a higher level of vocabulary control.
tips.kk: Табиғи сөз тіркестері лексиканы жоғары деңгейде меңгергеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Естественные словосочетания показывают более высокий уровень владения лексикой.
